name: Honda CB500F / CB500X
engine: 471 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Honda's light 500 twin. Several model years have recalls, from rocker arm bolts to the ABS unit.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Early 2013 CB500X bikes are in recall 14V056 (rocker arm shaft bolts). 2014-2015 bikes are in recall 15V439 (starter relay). Some 2019-2020 CB500X ABS bikes are in recall 21V690 (ABS modulator leak). Some 2020-2021 bikes are in recall 21V382 (rear reflector).

recalls.what: Rocker arm shaft retaining bolts may loosen.

recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the starter relay free.

recalls.what: Excess grease in the ABS modulator can trap debris and leak brake fluid.
Rear reflector lens may be too dim to meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear reflector free.
